question: How can I track my order?
answer: Open your order confirmation email and select Track order. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Remote-area deliveries may take a little longer.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from your order page.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: After we receive and inspect a return, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the secure reset link sent to your account email.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, UPI, and supported digital wallets at checkout. Available options are shown before you place an order.

question: Can I cancel or change an order?
answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your order number. Orders that have already shipped cannot be changed or cancelled.

question: What should I do if my item arrived damaged or incorrect?
answer: Please contact support@example.com within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging.

question: Why was I charged twice?
answer: One of the entries may be a temporary authorization that your bank will release, often within 3 to 5 business days. Contact support if both charges post.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@example.com with a short description of the issue. Include your order number when your question concerns a purchase.
